mapper.select: SELECT w.wallet_id, w.balance, w.status, u.pin FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.user_id = w.user_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_requests (wallet_id, senior_id, qr_token, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{seniorId}, #{qrToken}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT pr.payment_id, pr.wallet_id, pr.senior_id, pr.qr_token, pr.status, pr.transaction_id, pr.merchant_id, pr.amount, pr.failure_code, pr.expires_at, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, m.name AS merchant_name, t.completed_at AS paid_at, t.balance_after AS remaining_balance FROM payment_requests pr LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = pr.merchant_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = pr.transaction_id WHERE pr.payment_id = #{paymentId}

SELECT pr.payment_id, pr.wallet_id, pr.senior_id, pr.qr_token, pr.status, pr.transaction_id, pr.merchant_id, pr.amount, pr.failure_code, pr.expires_at, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, m.name AS merchant_name, t.completed_at AS paid_at, t.balance_after AS remaining_balance FROM payment_requests pr LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = pr.merchant_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = pr.transaction_id WHERE pr.qr_token = #{qrToken}

SELECT payment_id, wallet_id, senior_id, qr_token, status, transaction_id, merchant_id, amount, failure_code, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_requests WHERE qr_token = #{qrToken} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_requests SET status = 'PROCESSING', merchant_id = #{merchantId}, amount = #{amount} WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > NOW()
UPDATE payment_requests SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= NOW()
UPDATE payment_requests SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= NOW()
UPDATE payment_requests SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > NOW()
